svg.title: Load the child with its initial terminal descriptors
svg.desc: The SRAM overview contains the Kernel Image, Kernel Heap, Kernel Stack and Process and Shared Data Heap. The emulator host will store /output.txt outside SRAM. Dashed guides run from the bottom corners of the Kernel Heap band to the top corners of its expanded view. PCB 1 for the shell points to its FileDescriptorTable and its contiguous eight-entry array. Each object and each path string has its own BlockHeader. Only entries 1, 3 and 6 have their path allocations expanded. STDIN, STDOUT, STDERR, FILE and FREE abbreviate FILE_DESCRIPTOR constants. Amber outlines mark changed entries. Other allocations, flags and offsets are omitted. Teal arrows follow stored pointers. Amber call boxes and arrows identify the calls and the descriptor entries or tables they change. Each outlined group contains one process's descriptors above and its copied paths below. PCB 2 and its independent descriptor allocations are expanded in the second row. Block letters and widths do not specify allocation order or sizes.

g.text: PCBs · descriptor tables · entries · path strings
Kernel Heap · expanded · each path box is a separate copied string
